ui-queue.bulk.restored: {n} {product} wake-ups carried with the messages went back to the queue
ui-queue.jump.appended: Added to the running turn: the AI reads it at its next tool boundary, without being interrupted
ui-queue.jump.interrupting: Stopping the current turn; this message goes out right after
ui-queue.jump.interruptingWhy: {reason}; this message goes out right after
ui-queue.jump.merged: Merged with the message that jumped ahead; they go out together
ui-queue.jump.nextAfterJump: {reason}: goes out when the turn that jumped ahead ends
ui-queue.jump.nextFirst: First in line: goes out when the turn that is starting ends
ui-queue.jump.nextNotInterrupting: {reason}; goes out right after this turn ends
ui-queue.jump.nextSending: {reason}: goes out right after that turn ends
ui-queue.jump.nextStarting: {reason}: goes out right after it ends
ui-queue.jumpMerge.interrupting: Stopping the current turn, then sending right away
ui-queue.jumpMerge.joined: Joined the message that jumped ahead; they go out together
ui-queue.jumpMerge.nothing: Nothing to merge. The first one{carried}: {how}{rest}
ui-queue.jumpMerge.rest: ; the other {n} come from a different source, cannot be merged, and go out after this turn ends
ui-queue.jumpMerge.tookPlace: Goes out together with the {product} callbacks / events that jumped ahead
ui-queue.next.afterTurn: Goes out when the current turn ends
ui-queue.next.nextTurn: Goes out in the next turn ({why})
ui-queue.next.paused: Queue paused: tap “Resume queued messages” to send them in order
ui-queue.next.stopping: The current turn is stopping; then the queue pauses — tap “Resume queued messages” to send them in order
ui-queue.readingWidth.title: Reading width
ui-queue.rewind.edit.fallbackFiles: Editing a sent message. Sending first rewinds to just before it (it and everything after leave the session, and the model forgets them; files the AI changed with its edit tools since then go back whole to their content before this message, from {product}'s per-turn snapshots — others' changes to those files in the same turns are undone too; files changed by commands are not included (the rewind notice lists them); if those files changed again after the AI's turn, a file cannot be restored (for example one ignored by .gitignore), or a turn has no snapshot, the whole rewind is refused rather than undone halfway, and it says why), then sends the new text.
ui-queue.rewind.edit.nativeFiles: Editing a sent message. Sending first rewinds to just before it (it and everything after leave the session, and the model forgets them; files the AI changed with its edit tools go back to before this message too, but not files changed by commands; while the AI is offline files cannot be undone, and the rewind notice says so), then sends the new text.
ui-queue.rewind.edit.noFiles: Editing a sent message. Sending first rewinds to just before it (it and everything after leave the session, and the model forgets them; file changes are not undone), then sends the new text.
ui-queue.rewind.panel.fallbackFiles: Rewinds the last few turns (the model forgets them; the raw platform events stay for the audit). Also undo file changes: files the AI changed with its edit tools in these turns go back whole to their content before the rewind point, from {product}'s per-turn snapshots (others' changes to those files in the same turns are undone too); files changed by commands are not included. If those files changed again since, a file cannot be restored, or a turn has no snapshot, the whole rewind is refused rather than undone halfway, and it says why.
ui-queue.rewind.panel.nativeFiles: Rewinds the last few turns (the model forgets them; the raw platform events stay for the audit). Also undo file changes: files the AI changed with its edit tools in these turns go back to before the rewind point; files changed by commands are not included. While the AI is offline files cannot be undone, and the rewind notice says so.
ui-queue.rewind.panel.noFiles: Rewinds the last few turns (the model forgets them; the raw platform events stay for the audit). File changes are not undone; to restore files as well, turn on “{toggle}”.
ui-queue.rewind.panel.unsupported: Rewinds the last few turns (the model forgets them; the raw platform events stay for the audit). File changes are not undone: this AI cannot restore files on a rewind.
ui-queue.row.appended: Appended, waiting for the AI to read it
ui-queue.steer.attachments: Attachments can't be added to this turn
ui-queue.steer.finished: Terminal results go out with a new turn and can't be added to this turn
ui-queue.steer.keys: Enter to queue · ⌘/Ctrl+Enter to jump the queue
ui-queue.steer.unsupported: {harness} can't take additions to this turn
ui-queue.steerMerge.appended: {n} added to this turn (the AI reads them at its next tool boundary)
ui-queue.steerMerge.left: {n} can't be added and stay in the queue ({why})
ui-queue.steerMerge.merged: Merged {n, plural, one {# text} other {# texts}} and added them to this turn
ui-queue.steerMerge.none: Merged into one and added to this turn
